test_cases.title: Validate AC-01: AC-01 (Multi-Item Service Quotation Creation, Pricing, and Acceptance)
test_cases.objective:
AC-01: AC-01 (Multi-Item Service Quotation Creation, Pricing, and Acceptance):

In Service Quotation application', start new Quotation.

Select Transaction Type ZQDS — CE-Direct Sales

Give Description as 'RAR testing' and Sold-to Party as Brugmann Hospital

In the ‘Dates’ tab, In ‘Term of Quotation’ and give its Duration as 24 and Time Unit as Months

Items Tab line items:

Line Item 1: Product ID VELLYS SATELLITE STATION SKU1 ‘45157510101' , add Quantity 1, Plant BEV8, go to Sales Item Details add Price Details 'Z100' with  100% discount,  'ZSSP’ with  100,000 and Add Price 450,000 to  CE-Bndl Cont Price under Price Element. 

Line Item 2: Product ID VELLYS SATELLITE STATION SKU2 ‘45157510707' , add Quantity 1, Plant BEV8, go to Sales Item Details add Price Details  'Z100' with  100% discount,  'ZSSP’ with  100,000 and Add Price 450,000 to  CE-Bndl Cont Price under Price Element. 

Line Item 3: Product ID SAW INTERFACE LEFT (RUI) ‘45157022301' , add Quantity 1, Plant BEV8, go to Sales Item Details add Price Details  'Z100' with  100% discount,  'ZSSP’ with  100,000 

Line Item 4: Product ID SAW INTERFACE LEFT (SUI)‘45157022302' , add Quantity 1, Plant BEV8, go to Sales Item Details add Quantity 1, Plant BEV8, go to product add Price Details  'Z100' with  100% discount,  'ZSSP’ with  100,000 

Line Item 4: Product ID VELYS DIGITAL INSIGHT SUBSCRIPTION‘45157022900' , add Quantity 1, Plant BEV8, go to Sales Item Details add Quantity 1, Plant BEV8, go to product add Price Details  'Z100' with  100% discount,  'ZSSP’ with  100,000 

Return to the quotation and Save the Quotation and verify the Status is Quotation Created

Click on Edit to Change status to Released and Save and verify the Status: Released

Then Accept the quotation, and verify the Status Completed

Click the Transaction history to check the Sales order and Service contract

Click Service contract and select Status ‘Open’ to ‘Completed’.

Capture the Quotation number and status changes are recorded as evidence.

Copy Transaction id from Transaction History to use in “Manage Revenue Contracts

test_cases.title: Validate AC-02: AC-02 (Downstream Manage Revenue Contrac
test_cases.objective:
Verify behavior for AC-02 (Downstream Manage Revenue Contracts Processing):Verify that the Operational Document generated from AC-01 successfully appears in Manage Revenue Contracts:

1. Navigate to ‘Manage Revenue Contracts’
2. Then Navigate to Revenue contract popup, enter the Transaction id in Operational Document and click enter
3. Select all the Items with same Operational Document then click ok
4. Then click Go in the Manage Revenue Contract
5. Click on Revenue Contract to view details

test_cases.title: Validate AC-03: Create Outbound Delivery with Reference
test_cases.objective:
AC-03 (Create Outbound Delivery with reference):

Navigate to Create Outbound Delivery with reference

Select Plant as 'BEV8' and enter the Order Number

Then click on 'Picking' Tab and enter Storage Location as '6020' and picking quantity

Click on 'Post Goods issue'

Outbond Delivery and Material documen is created.

Capture Material number, to use in Create Billing Document scenario.

steps.description: Open SAP Fiori Logon screen
Enter SAP username
Enter SAP password
Click Log On button
Assert SAP Fiori Launchpad loaded
Navigate to Create Outbound Delivery with reference
Select Plant / Shipping Point as '${plant}'
Enter Order Number '${OPERATIONAL_DOCUMENT}' copied from AC-01
Press 'Enter' into Order Required to open delivery items
Click on 'Picking' Tab
Select Storage Location cell in Picking tab
Enter Storage Location as '${storage_location}'
Select Picking Quantity cell in Picking tab
Enter picking quantity as '${picking_quantity}'
Click on 'Post Goods Issue'
Verify Outbound Delivery and Material document is created and capture Material number
Click User Profile Avatar Menu
Click Sign Out
Confirm Sign Out dialog
Verify returned to Logoff screen

test_cases.expected_result: Outbound Delivery and Material document is created and Material/Delivery number captured for Create Billing Document [AC-03]

test_cases.title: Validate AC-04: Create Billing Document and Verify Fully Invoiced
test_cases.objective:
AC-04 (Create Billing Document):

Navigate to Create Billing Document

Enter the Document number which you copied in the previous test case.

select the Document and check if its Fully Invoiced in the Processing Status

Verify Billing Number is created

steps.description: Open SAP Fiori Logon screen
Enter SAP username
Enter SAP password
Click Log On button
Assert SAP Fiori Launchpad loaded
Navigate to Create Billing Document
Enter the Document number '${MATERIAL_DOCUMENT}' copied in the previous test case into Documents to Be Processed
Press 'Enter' into Documents to Be Processed
Click Save to create Billing Document
Select the Document and check if it is '${processing_status}' in the Processing Status and verify Billing Number is created
Click User Profile Avatar Menu
Click Sign Out
Confirm Sign Out dialog
Verify returned to Logoff screen

test_cases.expected_result: Document is Fully Invoiced in Processing Status and Billing Number is created [AC-04]
